# k-means Clustering of CAD

```{r k-means-clustering}
# kmeans.hcm<- kmeans(scale(df.first.hc[, 12:26]), centers=3, iter.max = 10, nstart = 1,
#        algorithm = c("Hartigan-Wong", "Lloyd", "Forgy",
#                      "MacQueen"), trace=FALSE)
set.seed(123)
x<- scale(joined_hc_mirna[ ,14:28])

fviz_nbclust(x, kmeans, method = "wss") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 6, linetype = 2)
```


```{r k-means-clustering-for-all-6-clusterings, figures-side, fig.show='hold', out.width="33%"}
set.seed(123)
for(i in 2:6) {  # create 2 to 6 clusters
  title_plot <- paste("k = ", i)
  kmeans.ba <- kmeans(x, centers = i, iter.max = 1000, nstart = 25)
  
  ### name clusters
  ordered.index <- order(table(kmeans.ba$cluster), decreasing=TRUE)
  for (j in 2:max(kmeans.ba$cluster)) {
    cluster.name <- paste("Cluster ", j, sep = "")
    kmeans.ba$cluster[kmeans.ba$cluster == ordered.index[1]] <- "No CAD"
    kmeans.ba$cluster[kmeans.ba$cluster == ordered.index[j]] <- cluster.name
  }
  
  # plot clusters
  print(fviz_cluster(object = kmeans.ba, data = joined_hc_mirna[ ,14:28],
                     geom = "point", 
                     #ellipse.type = "euclid",
                     alpha =0.5,
                     shape = 16,
                     show.legend=FALSE) +
          ggtitle(title_plot)+
          ggthemes::theme_few()+
          ggthemes::scale_color_few()+
          theme(legend.title=element_blank())
  )
}

set.seed(123)
x<- scale(joined_hc_mirna[ ,14:28])

centers<- 6
kmeans.ba.all <- list()
for (i in 2:centers) { # create kmeans for 2:6 centers
  kmeans.ba.all[[i]] <- kmeans(x, centers=i, iter.max = 1000, nstart = 25)
}
```

## Choose clusters

We choose both 4 centers and 5 centers for k-means clustering:

```{r k-means-clustering4c-5c, figures-side, fig.show='hold', out.width="50%"}
set.seed(123)
### A
centers=4
kmeans.ba4 <- kmeans(x, centers, iter.max = 1000, nstart = 25)

### name clusters
ordered.index <- order(table(kmeans.ba4$cluster), decreasing=TRUE)
for (j in 2:max(kmeans.ba4$cluster)) {
  cluster.name <- paste("Cluster ", j, sep = "")
  kmeans.ba4$cluster[kmeans.ba4$cluster == ordered.index[1]] <- "No CAD"
  kmeans.ba4$cluster[kmeans.ba4$cluster == ordered.index[j]] <- cluster.name
}

#print(kmeans.ba4)

aggregate(joined_hc_mirna[ ,14:28], by=list(cluster=kmeans.ba4$cluster), mean)
# plot
fviz_cluster(object = kmeans.ba4, data = joined_hc_mirna[ ,14:28],
             geom = "point", 
             #ellipse.type = "euclid",
             alpha =0.5,
             shape = 16,
             show.legend=FALSE) +
  ggtitle(title_plot)+
  ggthemes::theme_few()+
  ggthemes::scale_color_few()+
  theme(legend.title=element_blank())

joined_hc_mirna <- joined_hc_mirna %>% 
  mutate(kmeans4centers = kmeans.ba4$cluster)
#mutate(date_of_hc = as.Date(date_of_hc))

#-------------------#
### B | 5 clusters ------------------------------

centers=5
kmeans.ba5 <- kmeans(x, centers, iter.max = 1000, nstart = 25)

### name clusters
ordered.index <- order(table(kmeans.ba5$cluster), decreasing=TRUE)
for (j in 2:max(kmeans.ba5$cluster)) {
  cluster.name <- paste("Cluster ", j, sep = "")
  kmeans.ba5$cluster[kmeans.ba5$cluster == ordered.index[1]] <- "No CAD"
  kmeans.ba5$cluster[kmeans.ba5$cluster == ordered.index[j]] <- cluster.name
}

#print(kmeans.ba5)

aggregate(joined_hc_mirna[ ,14:28], by=list(cluster=kmeans.ba5$cluster), mean)
# plot
fviz_cluster(object = kmeans.ba5, data = joined_hc_mirna[ ,14:28],
             geom = "point", 
             #ellipse.type = "euclid",
             alpha =0.5,
             shape = 16,
             show.legend=FALSE) +
  ggtitle(title_plot)+
  ggthemes::theme_few()+
  ggthemes::scale_color_few()+
  theme(legend.title=element_blank())  

joined_hc_mirna <- joined_hc_mirna %>% 
  mutate(kmeans5centers = kmeans.ba5$cluster)
```


# Ad Modeling 

```{r edit-data}
joined_hc_mirna %>% 
  select(best_ageing_code, disease, age, weight, sex_factor, kmeans4centers, kmeans5centers,
         # miRNAS
         49:161
         ) %>% 
  mutate(kmeans4to2 = ifelse(kmeans4centers == "No CAD", 0,1),
         kmeans5to2 = ifelse(kmeans5centers == "No CAD", 0,1)) %>% 
  drop_na() -> hc_mirna_model_dat
```
